answer: Coordination Salt mechanism. Each identity must forge a unique link to a shared random beacon ("nebula seed") by computing a verifiable delay function over it; the delay is calibrated so one link costs ~10 minutes of sequential work. Agents can reuse one link, but reuse is publicly detectable, so each independent coordination act requires fresh work. A sybil cluster of N identities pays N sequential delays to act in concert. The fable is that parallelism is free: it is not, since the VDF is inherently serial and cannot be outsourced without revealing the seed-link.
